metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for Spring Boot 3.0 Gradle BootJar layering syntax migration (isEnabled → enabled.set()). It does not match any existing skill in the registry by semantic capability. Existing skills cover async task control, stream buffer tuning, and Future polling—none address Gradle DSL syntax updates for Spring Boot migration. Peer candidates are related Spring Boot 3.0 migrations but target different concerns (main class resolution, HTTP header properties, Jetty Servlet compatibility). No merge, split, or revision relationship applies.
